name: Watchman Joren
look: A gaunt border militiaman in a dented kettle-helm with soot smeared across both cheeks.
prop: A notched halberd and a cracked horn lantern.
line_first: Keep low by the gatehouse—their archers have the cobbled lane ranged to the inch.
line_return: Gate timbers are holding, barely. Tell Garrick we need iron wedges.

name: Clerk Oswin
look: A shivering middle-aged scribe clutching a wet wool cloak over ink-stained fingers.
prop: A brass-bound tally slate and a broken padlock.
line_first: Three months of river tariffs sank in that ditch! Don't let the gnolls chew the box.
line_return: If the silver's gone, Thornwick's militia won't stay past sundown.

name: Peat-Cutter Mara
look: A wiry woman wrapped in greased horsehide with mud dried up to her thighs.
prop: A long iron-shod peat spade.
line_first: Step only on the black tussocks—green moss hides sinkholes deep enough to swallow a horse.
line_return: Keep your torches hooded; bog-lights draw things with teeth.

name: Runner Talia
look: A breathless young outrider with a blood-soaked bandage wrapped around her left calf.
prop: An empty leather dispatch tube.
line_first: The bone totems in the pines are feeding their wards—burn them before night falls!
line_return: My leg won't carry me back up the ridge, so make every arrow count.

name: Sawyer Dobb
look: A broad-shouldered woodcutter missing two fingers, wearing a sawdust-caked leather apron.
prop: A two-man crosscut saw slung over one shoulder.
line_first: Tarn's turncoats locked our best iron axes inside the central timber shed.
line_return: Burn their pork barrels, just leave the seasoned oak planks intact.

name: Warden Hale
look: A sun-darkened ranger in salt-stiffened rawhide with a cracked spyglass hung at his neck.
prop: A curved horn-bow and a bundle of signal flags.
line_first: Dust storms roll off the basin without warning—keep horns close or lose half your column.
line_return: The ridge blinds are clear for now, though raiders still prowl the dry arroyos.

name: Miner Tomas
look: A stocky quarryman covered in black ironstone dust with raw chain-chafes around his wrists.
prop: A heavy steel quarry-pick.
line_first: Break the slave-pen locks on the middle terrace and three hundred picks join your line!
line_return: Gorrathul's overseers hid the hoist keys in the pit—bury them.

name: Drover Vane
look: A one-eyed caravan driver with cracked lips and a salt-crusted felt hat.
prop: A braided rawhide mule-whip.
line_first: My lead mules bolted when the sand-raiders whistled—help me haul these crates off the flats!
line_return: Never trust a dry creek bed at noon; lurkers sleep two inches under the crust.

name: Surveyor Nira
look: An indigo-robed scholar squinting through smoked-quartz spectacles against blowing grit.
prop: A brass plumb-bob and charcoal rubbing-pad.
line_first: The quartz spire is cracking! Kill the blood-chanters before the static cooks us alive!
line_return: Keep those rubbings dry—Zahra will need every glyph on that parchment.

name: Sentry Kell
look: A hollow-cheeked pikeman leaning heavily on a spear beside a chained iron well-cover.
prop: A battered copper ladle.
line_first: One drop of beetle-bile ruins a whole cistern—keep those scourges off the stone rim!
line_return: Water's rationed to half a pint till Bram's wagons reach the gate.

name: Corporal Brenn
look: A salt-cured infantry corporal in a rusted breastplate with seaweed tangled in his greaves.
prop: A notched boarding-axe.
line_first: Watch the tide-lines—heavy mail sinks like an anchor when the surf rolls over the spit!
line_return: Hold the plank-walk; Oakhaven's marines are right behind you.

name: Pilot Maren
look: A weather-beaten coast pilot in oiled yellow canvas with brass dividers tucked in his sash.
prop: A salt-stained sounding lead and line.
line_first: You have two hours before spring tide floods the lower ward—move fast or drown in plate!
line_return: Keep off the kelp-slick steps; one slip drops you straight into the sluice.

name: Apothecary Linn
look: A pale apprentice surgeon in a vinegar-soaked apron with blood dried under her fingernails.
prop: A wicker tray of boiled linen rolls.
line_first: Keep those cleaver-happy raiders off the tent ropes—half our wounded can't even crawl!
line_return: Sera's loading the last stretchers now; hold the creek trail ten more minutes.

name: Lock-Keeper Orin
look: A grease-stained canal mechanic with a swollen bruised shoulder and a heavy iron wrench.
prop: A three-foot iron gear-wedge.
line_first: Drive these wedges into the center capstan before their sappers trip the floodgates!
line_return: Those gears won't turn again this winter—the east bridge is safe.

name: Fire-Warden Cole
look: A soot-blackened dockworker coughing through a wet wool scarf tied over his nose.
prop: A hooked fire-pike and sand bucket.
line_first: Pitch-pots are raining off Kael's flagship—clear the seawall stairs so we can douse the piers!
line_return: Save the drydocks first; without hulls, we never cross the southern straits.

name: Ash-Scout Riven
look: A lean vanguard scout in soot-grey leather with smoked-glass goggles pushed onto his forehead.
prop: A bundle of white-chalked warning stakes.
line_first: Stay off the yellow crust—boiling sulfur sits two inches beneath that brittle shell!
line_return: Highcrest bluff is clear, though the ash-storms are thickening to the east.

name: Sapper Garr
look: A squat, burn-scarred engineer wearing thick leather welding gauntlets and an iron visor.
prop: A keg of black prism-powder.
line_first: Cover my team while we set the charges on the West Conduit—one spark ends us early!
line_return: Charges are primed; clear the dais before the stone splits.

name: Watchman Varo
look: A exhausted Greystone defender in cracked basalt-dusted plate with a sling on his left arm.
prop: A heavy steel windlass crossbow.
line_first: Three demonic catapults are chewing our east parapet to gravel—sally out and burn them!
line_return: Parapet's patched with pumice mortar, though my ears are still ringing.

name: Penitent Sola
look: A barefoot ash-robed witness carrying a chain of tarnished brass name-plates.
prop: A small iron censer smoking with grey ash.
line_first: Speak softly in the nave—the First Watch still stands bound to those obsidian pillars.
line_return: Two doors, two prices. Choose which temperature you want for Thornvael.

name: Stoker Brann
look: A shirtless, keloid-scarred forge-hand wearing a heavy asbestos-lined leather apron.
prop: Long iron crucible tongs.
line_first: Vok needs slag-billets from the lower vents before we can re-temper your vanguard's shields!
line_return: Keep your steel oiled; volcanic fumes pit bare iron in half an hour.
